source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Design phase (PDF 8).

blocks.text: Design ke marhale mein hum mansooba banate hain ke software kaisa dikhega aur kaise kaam karega. Yeh ghar banane se pehle naqsha (blueprint) khainchne jaisa hai.

items: Diagrams banana: dikhana ke software ke hisse kaise jurte aur mil kar kaam karte hain, maslan program ke qadmon ka flowchart.
Models banana: software ki banawat dikhana, jaise user interface ke mock-ups (namoone).
Architecture ka mansooba: majmooi banawat aur hisson ka aapas mein taamul tay karna.
Requirements wazeh karna: har hisse ka kaam saaf likhna ta ke kuch reh na jaye.

blocks.text: Yeh qadam aakhri software ko munazzam, user ke liye aasan aur un ki zarooraton ke mutabiq banate hain. Is marhale ko naya ghar design karne jaisa samjhein: banana shuru karne se pehle naqshe chahiyein jo dikhayein ke kamre aur furniture kahan honge.

blocks.prompt: Long question 1 user registration ke amal ka flowchart maangta hai. Is ke aham qadam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Shuru; user sign-up form khol kar naam, email aur password daalta hai; nizam tafseel jaanchta hai (kya email durust aur pehle se istemal nahi, kya password kaafi mazboot hai?); agar nahi to ghalti dikha kar form par wapas; agar haan to account mehfooz kar ke tasdeeqi paigham bhejna; khatam. Flowchart mein shuru aur khatam gol shaklein, qadam mustateel, jaanch diamond aur teer tarteeb dikhate hain.

items: Design: mansooba ke software kaisa dikhega aur kaam karega, ghar ke naqshe ki tarah.
Qadam: diagrams (flowcharts), models (UI mock-ups), architecture ka mansooba, requirements wazeh karna.
